scope: All units read: translation and word glosses against the Telugu text. The text was not compared with the source.

items.issue: పామిడి తురగపు పాదము was “the foot swift as a coursing steed”, while the word gloss took it as the foot of the rider of the horse, Kalki; the two disagreed.
items.change: Translation now “the foot that mounts the swift horse (as Kalki)”, the usual reading, matching the words.
